name: K-X12 probe droid
description: The MerenData KX-12 probe droid was a multi-function droid model commonly used around 3956 BBY and 3951 BBY. Billed as a probe droid by its manufacturer, it gained popularity for its adaptability. It was a nonhumanoid model equipped with a red photoreceptor, three multi-jointed appendages equipped with claw graspers, a blaster, and a repulsorlift.
